context:
joyous #74 is CI green but blocked. Ruleset 24853807 ("main") requires the checks `ste-lint` and `build`. #74 moves the lint into the shared `checks` job, so no `ste-lint` check runs any more. The shared form requires only all-jobs-passed. Of the 7 child repos, only joyous has such a rule (read 02:56 CST).

Why yours: the cloud cannot change a ruleset. Your standing grant "Acts the cloud refuses" (2026-10-30 16:20 CDT) lets a session on your computer do it, but none is reachable now (no computer folder, no peer session). Opening a computer session works too.

After: batch runner 9 runs the merge of #74 again.
home: claude-settings standing grant "Acts the cloud refuses"
steps: Under "Require status checks to pass", remove `ste-lint` and `build`, add `all-jobs-passed`, and save. Or delete the ruleset: branch protection already requires all-jobs-passed.
title: Set joyous's "main" ruleset to the shared form, so joyous #74 can merge
